models_evaluated: seven other traditional machine learning algorithms

links.outcome: ASA classification accuracy of LLMs versus traditional machine learning on the same data
links.effect: GPT-4o Few Shot Feature LLM reached 66% accuracy, F1 0.65, AUROC 0.79, versus 54% accuracy for the best traditional method (LightGBM), a 12-percentage-point improvement.
links.quote: Large language models outperformed traditional machine learning for ASA classification in this dataset, particularly in intermediate-risk patients comprising most surgical cases.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively benchmarks various LLMs against traditional ML models for predicting ASA physical status classification on an EHR dataset without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
